notes: FirstSeen Desktop V10.2.9 bundles Browser CRM V2.4. This fixes the editable cold-call script save controls, adds clear success/failure feedback, preserves prospect-only and all-prospect persistence, and formats the large opening script with every sentence on its own line for easier live reading. Existing Twilio browser calling, call outcomes, follow-ups, Finder shortlist, SQLite CRM data and updater behaviour are preserved.
